Step by step:

1. The manager is on the far left, so position 1 is the manager.
2. The manager is somewhere to the left of the person who eats peach, so peach must be in position 2 or 3.
3. The engineer is on the far left or far right. Since position 1 is already the manager, the engineer must be in position 3.
4. The engineer and the peach eater have the same parity position. Position 3 is odd, so the peach eater must also be in an odd position. Since position 1 is the manager and peach must be to the right of them, peach is in position 3.
5. The remaining job is project-manager, so position 2 is the project-manager.
6. The manager is not to the left of the chess player. Since the manager is in position 1, the chess player must also be in position 1.
7. House is immediately next to chess, so house is in position 2.
8. The engineer is in position 3, and the skydiving person has a different parity position, so skydiving is in position 2.
9. Spinach is the same person as r&b. Since position 3 eats peach and position 2 listens to house, spinach/r&b must be position 1.
10. Therefore position 2 eats cabbage, and position 3 listens to folk.

<solution>2, folk, manager, project-manager</solution>
